summary: Vistra Corp. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to two credit agreements entered into by its subsidiary Vistra Operations Company LLC on June 24, 2026. The Credit Agreement Amendment increased revolving commitments from $3.44 billion to $5.50 billion, released guarantees, removed collateral reinstatement requirements, and modified covenants. The Commodity-Linked Credit Agreement Amendment released guarantees and made conforming changes. This is a routine refinancing and credit facility amendment, not a special situation. Terms are not publicly disclosed beyond the aggregate commitment increase. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event occurred.
